source.acquisition: Merged bounded OSM map API responses; duplicate elements use the highest version; raw responses outside Git
source.normalization: highway ways, their referenced nodes, explicit pedestrian restriction relations; all tags and element versions/timestamps; no editor identities
source.snapshotNote: OSM map API does not supply a global snapshot timestamp. Element timestamps are retained; fetchedAt is not a database snapshot guarantee.
